name: A/B/O Speed Dating
source:
Birth rates are declining in the Omegaverse -- so the government sponsors speed dating events to get more people coupled up.

Your friend signs up for one but asks you to take their place at the last minute. 

Play as a handsome (or cute) man going on a speed date with 3 kooky characters!

[From [url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/abo-speed-dating]itch.io[/url]]
